teaser: Our next stage is a CRM of our own, on vaults with an iOS app, for us and our agents. Twenty leads the field; agents propose, people send.
core_idea: Build the CRM record on vaults with first-class introductions and drafts, borrow the agentic CRMs' proposal and draft patterns, and run two teams: one builds, one uses.

quotes.text: So I think a CRM is a product in itself, and it should have an iOS app of its own
for us they are the heart of it
Customer relationship management is really relationship management
and no agent ever sends an email or posts. A person does.

figures.caption: Two teams: one builds the CRM, one uses it, under behaviour policies where only a person sends.
Managing a fleet of agents is relationship management: the same records, almost one to one, and what we have.
The CRM landscape through an agent's eyes: licence, agents or MCP, writes as proposals, drafts rather than sends.
A small data model: people, organisations, interactions, introductions, follow-ups, drafts and plays.
